note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl and math500_rl-01/rows.jsonl (in the repo, no fetch needed). Fields used: problem_index, sample, attempt, n_new, cap_hit, score_v3. Main: attempt==0 rows only, all 8 rows score_v3==1 and cap_hit False, CV with ddof=0, drop problems with either CV 0, short = base median n_new <= 2000, median of ln(CV_base/CV_RL). Duplicate attempt-0 rows for one (problem, sample) would exclude the problem (none expected: 2000 attempt-0 rows per file). The ddof choice cancels in the ratio since both models have n=4. Alt reading: use each sample's final attempt (highest attempt, i.e. after retries) instead of attempt 0, since the files contain retries (base 137, RL 41 rows with attempt>0); same filters otherwise. Shared code in common.py next to the scripts.

Same files, filters and L as k=4 (shared common.py). Long = base median n_new > 2000. Statistic = median L(short) - median L(long), even counts use the mean of the two middle values. If the long group is empty the script reports not_computable (the recipe does not say an empty group refutes). Long group may be small because cap-hit rows and long base answers often co-occur, so the long median can be noisy. Alt reading: final attempt per sample instead of attempt 0.
